hook_text: The bus leaves at 21:45. Is that 11:45 p.m.? Miss that bus and you will find out.
clip_script: Overnight bus, Johannesburg to Durban! The ticket says 21:45. What time is that? After noon, the 24-hour clock just keeps counting. Take away 12: 9:45 p.m. Not 11:45! Morning times look normal: 07:30 is 7:30 a.m. Afternoon: add 12. 2:15 p.m. is 14:15. Midnight? 00:00. And the beach race: 01:05,32. That is 65,32 seconds!
visual_style: A night bus station with a big departure board, a spinning analogue clock morphing into digital numbers.
mood: Urgent then relieved, like catching a bus just in time.
pacing: Quick hook, clear conversions, then a fun stopwatch finish.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write your school day in 24-hour time.
